entry.title: LizstarTrek - Prodigy Season 2 Episodes 1 -
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

This is an interesting one. Fully 3D animated, so the third animated Trek show, and Trek does quite well in animation, though it’s never been 3D. This one is ALSO… for kids! That’s not a bad thing. Some of the best shows of all time are for kids. I don’t expect this to be like, Avatar or Gravity Falls levels, but I expect this to be the real last bright spot in the Trek ouvre.

After season 1, I was quite impressed, so I’m also very ready for season 2! And considering how Paramount almost fucking killed it for no reason, I am even more intrigued. Cause I’ve seen what shit they let live.

Into the Breach, Part I+II - PRO 6/10

We start basically right before the final part of the last season. All the cadets are dragged out of classes and stuff in order to join Janeway on a new ship and mission. They’re all the same characters you love, really, though Jankom claims he is trying to be less rude.

Look who comes to pick them up! It’s ya boi. This really IS Voyager 2. One of these fucking days we’ll get sequels to DS9 stuff. But that day is not today, and I’ll accept Voyager 2. Instead of taking the Protostar from the last season, they go to the Voyager. Well, a new and upgraded Voyager.

Our kids aren’t the only cadets here. Some Alpha Squadron cadets too. ….We still have those? We didn’t disband that shit?!

They’re all seperated pretty much immediately and put in different sections of the ship. I mean, obviously. They’re basically lower decks on this ship and are in entirely different sections. Some of them are super into this, like Rok. After the last season, Dal has illusions of grandeur and is annoyed he’s not like, on the bridge making commands. Dude you’re 13.

Dal is in a skype call with his girlfriend in Canada (Gwen) who IS still here but is almost to her home planet to try and stop its civil war. Dal is worried this means she’ll make it so she never exists. As Rok said literally 6 minutes ago, “You clearly haven’t read temporal mechanics 101” cause that is not how this works in this universe.

They get hints that there’s something sneaky going on on this ship, and it’s in the restricted shuttle bay 3. They all sneak in just in time to catch the people in charge talking about how the mission is cancelled, cause of Jellico. Fucking JELLICO. The plan WAS to use a shuttle to go in the wormhole invented at the end of the last season and then retrieve Chakotay, but Starfleet is kinda worried about what it’ll do to the timeline, which is fair.

Gwyn shows up on her home planet, but Ascensia, the evil one from the previous season shows up. She’s OBVIOUSLY evil, but y’know, people being idiots. So she has to escape as they try to arrest her. Her escort who brought her here is blown up, and she’s now stranded. Whoopsies!

As they near the anomaly, they are met with a weird glowing orb that goes “JANEWAY, DON’T ENTER THE ANOMALY, GO THE FUCK AWAY”. A good sign. Also because of Dal being an idiot, they’re now in the thick of it too. In 41 hours they’ll need to go into the wormhole and rescue Chakotay. Aaaaand of course, they IMMEDIATELY narc on the fucking secret mission because they are incompetent, and one of the Nova Squadron peoples, a Vulcan named Majel (Eyyy) plans to tell Starfleet Command. Uh. Why? Just to be an asshole? Obviously if there was a secret mission, Janeway is in on it? I mean obviously they’re Nova Squadron so they’re just awful people in general.

Back with Gwyn, she meets with her dad. Or well, the person who would become her dad. He’s just an astronomer right now. She convinces him, and he seems like a friendly and nice guy who’s into knowledge and other worlds, but cause of that he has little power or sway cause his people are not into that kinda shit right now. He tells her about an ancient Vau Nakat practice that will get them to recognize her. IF SHE LIVES. These people are very Klingon.

Due to Majel being a fucking asshole, they accidentally launch the ship into the wormhole way too early. Whoopsies!

Who Saves the Saviors - PRO 6/10

We’re now split into THREE different settings. Rok and Murf are back in the present with Janeway. Zero, Dal, Jankom, and Majel are in the future, immediately captured and thrown in jail with Chakotay and his Aurelian XO. And finally, Gwen is still trying to stop her world from falling into fascism. She challenges Asencia to ritual combat, which involves going down a giant elevator while fighting with their heirloom weapons. It’s like a fuckign video game scene. It’s sick.

You know, all during Voyager’s watching, I kept hearing how much better Chakotay is in this show over Voyager. Well guess what? Still boring with no personality. Also easily distracted and hyper focusing on thing sthat don’t fucking matter. Does chakotay have undiagnosed ADHD? In this essay I will.

Also he just fucking takes the Protostar and tries to fly back into the wormhole to escape. This COMPLETELY changes the timeline, and is bad. It’ll overwrite Gwyn existing, and in fact, she starts to phase out like she’s Marty McFuckingFly. I’ve NEVER seen anything like that ever happen, but JUST because of this she loses the fight. Fucking Chakotay, ruining everything as always. Fucking Chakotay!!!

Temporal Mechanics 101 - PRO 7/10

Shit is bad. The timeline hasn’t fully changed yet due to some phlebtonium they set up, but it’s only a matter of time. Gwyn is McFlying in her father’s arms, and they have no clue how to fix this. But as they’re freaking out, they get a weird message.

They follow it to the chamber Gwyn is in a long time ago, and find she’s also there now. Dog, I dunno what they’re doing with time. Time travel is just calvinball now. I guess thats very Trek.

Back in the present, Gwyn is still kinda here. She talks to her father, who finds out he was a horrible asshole in the future. But he’s like “I’m not him now. I’m here for you.” So hey, it’s nice that he’s not warped into a fascist by the rigors of civil war and PTSD. Anyone can become evil :)

They have a plan, but to figure it out exactly, they need to do a 101 crash course on temporal mechanics. Janeway sends Dal a fucking video on his padd. It’s very silly. They need to build a time machine, but Jankom has been down in the dumps cause nothing is working how it should, even though he followed it entirely by the book. He solves this by percussive maintenence. “JANKOM POG IS BACK, BABY!”

They go back to the future, grab Gwen, and try to escape in their ship, which is broken to fuck, but suddenly becomes workable. They assume it’s cause of their mysterious benefactor who sent the original message. They make it back to the present. But who’s the mysterious benefactor???

IT’S THE SHADOWY FUTURE GUY FROM ENTERPRISE! (No, obviously not)

Observer’s Paradox - PRO 6.5/10

They’re all questioned after all of the nonsense of the last few episodes and are given restricted access. Dal is like “This blows!” Dude you almost fucked up the timestream. Just accept your failures alongside your victories. And now he wants to dig further. They DO find out Murf seems to know something, but no one can really communicate with Murf.

Majel is back to ignoring them and being a haughty bitch, despite everything they went through. I see where this plotline is gonna go. They are also pushing a Majel x Zero relationship which… would be queer rep, tbf!

Zero takes one for the team, distracting the Doctor by asking him about the holo novels he’s working on, as Dal and the others sneak out to try and talk to Murf. JUST TELL THE ADULTS ABOUT THIS.

They try and invent a way to talk to Murf. It doesn’t go great. But Gwyn discovers that the weird spiral that Murf made to TRY and communicate connects to… Chakotay. Fuckin’ Chokie. We are far from the spirals of our ancestors.

They get the whale in Cetacean Ops to help them out. THey think they can use her to communicate with Murf, and she agrees to immediately cause she really likes Rok.

Gillian the Whale translates for him and gives them “FIND ME” and some random numbers.

Meanwhile, Janeway has to close the wormhole due to Starfleet orders, which she does. That MIGHT mean they can’t ever save Chakotay, but… I mean, obviously not :P

Gwyn uses the numbers to go to a time between dimensions and finds Chakotay. THis also tells her how to find Chakotay, apparently. Using the spirals? I don’t geddit.

Imposter Syndrome - PRO 7/10

We start with a cold open of everyone chasing Dal and trying to murder him. We quickly find out what that was about, as 24 hours prior, we see they plan to “borrow” the shuttle, and are going to make holograms to sit around and pretend to be them.

While setting up the Holograms, Janeway comes in and the Holograms have to hide instead of just… beign turned off. They hide like how dogs hide, it is very obvious. There’s no way Janeway doesn’t know, she’s not THAT stupid right??

Obviously shit goes bad quick. The holograms think they’re real, and thus try and lock the real ones up and go off to steal the ship they wanna steal. Fun premise, especially cause it’s impossible to properly tell who’s who. All the holograms start to pair off and fight the real versions of themselves…. except for Rok. Who teams up with her hologram to try and find a peaceful way to solve this. Yeah, that makes sense.

With THAT solved, they need to try and get to the shuttle before its destroyed. Majel helps them escape, as she “knows who her real friends are”, and then she flirts with Zero. It’s actually pretty cute. THey all make it to the shuttle and steal it, blasting off and leaving their holograms behind… who then end up glitching and swapping personalities. Whoops!

The Fast and the Curious - PRO 7/10

The crew have 61 days till they get to the nebula, buuuut it can be much faster if they go through a transwarp conduit! Oh boy, MORE BORG. I sure do love modern Borg.

Actually its NOT the Borg! They’re attacked mid transit and dragged to a planet, where some Kazon take them hostage. Oh my GOD, fucking Kazon. The Maje they’re taken to is a bit weird. He will let them escape if they can beat his personally trained pilot in a race course. Zero and Murf escape and try to get the ship operational.

Meanwhile, shit is weird back on Voyager. Everyone is acting weird. And for some reason the adults mostly ignore it.

We get a big podrace-style race in flying skiffs. Everyone is split into teams of two. Dal is immediately competitive for no reason, and people might actually die. Hell, cause of his recklessness, Gwyn is almost destabilized temporally again. Also this entire time, the Maje continues to be really weird.

Twist, it turns out the Maje is being mind controlled by some evil AI! Zero and Murf free him from it. Basically, he was in charge of a pilot training course. The AI took over him and made him force racers to fight each other in death races over and over to find the best racer. And the AI has started stealing people from Transwarp to keep reaching her goal. She immediately takes over Murf, which is scary as hell.

Zero breaks out of their bonds and slams into the AI, destroying her, but also breaking their containment suit in the process. Zero is completely unable to control their body anymore, but at least they’re safe for now. Poor Zero ):

The episode ends with some weird time tendrils bursting into the Voyager, pausing time, and destroying the Gwyn hologram, getting angry it was just a hologram, and disappearing. I’m sure that won’t be a problem.

Is There In Beauty No Truth? - PRO 8/10

Zero gets a message from a nearby Medusan, who tells them about a planet of incorporeal life forms who can help them out and get them a more stable body. The incorporeals had formed a colony, and made physical bodies that allows them to experience senses. Their bodies let them see and feel…. it’s almost cult-like.

Back on Voyager, they find out about the holograms and chase after them. Janeway is piiissssed. Maybe you should have fucking TOLD HER, DAL?! You and her shared a body, it’s too late to be coy!

Zero gets their body, and the first thing they experience is Rok hugging them. Aww, that’s cute. They are VERY happy to finally experience senses. Time for things to immediately turn bad :)

During this big feast, it ends with “The Running of the Nazzamon”, where they focus on the most exhilerating sensation: Fear. Basically they run from this giant flying mantaray. I love it, it’s perfect, it’s my favorite thing in Star Trek now.

They all survive the ordeal, and Zero LOVES their new body. They also know that they can’t leave their friends, and even if their body dulls without upkeep, they will never abandon them. That’s sweet.

Back on Voyager, they recover the Gwyn hologram, which immediately has a panic attack like “IT’S COMING BACK FOR ME, I CAN STILL HEAR IT, HELP ME IT’S GOING TO KILL ME, GOD HELP ME”. Holy shit. Her programs been corrupted by the fucking Orz.

The Devourer of All Things, Part I - PRO 7/10

They reach the planet the clues led them to, but it’s out of phase. So they do some sciency stuff with the Heisenberg Compensators to land on the planet. The planet is… weird. They heard voices talking on the wind, see some old statues, and find a bank vault. Inside hte bank vault is Chokie… OR NOT!

God he looks weird here.

Meanwhile, Jellico is like “I ORDERED you to return to earth!” and Janeway does the fucking “Oh, I can’t hear ytou, I’m going through a transwarp tunnel!” I love her. Fuckin’ Jellico being awful as always> How did that guy become an admiral?

Anyways, Wesley has a LOT to go over and very little time. Wesley quickly explains to them about who he is, and what the Travelers are here for. He also explains multiversal theory to them. Thanks to all the problems, this universe is trying to exist in two states at once, and is unraveling entirely because of it. They also apparently invite in “cosmic scavengers” from outside time to eat dying timelines. The travelers deemed this too hard to fix, but Wesley likes this timeline cause y’know, his mom lives here, so he’s gonna fix it.

Wesley keeps mentioning sweaters for some reason. It’s absolutely a situation of like “Fuck, what kind of personality did Wesley have???? Um…. he wore sweaters!” This is barely Wesley. He’s now like, a neurotic fast talking weird guy. He’s not really Wesley anymore. Honestly, it’s just Wil Weaton pretending to be the Doctor from Dr. Who.

While trying to fix it, time freezes and the time scavengers show up to eat them. He calls them the Loom. Now Gwyn and Wesley are alone, trying to escape them. They manage to escape, taking the others with them, and find their way to… FUCKING GARY SEVEN’S OFFICE. CHRIST, GARY FUCKING SEVEN.

Meanwhile, Janeway shows up like “let’s go down and explore that planet :D” which is filled with clicking horrifying time eaters.

The Devourer of All Things, Part II - PRO 8/10

Lots of hints and winks at Gary Seven to nerds like me who’d care, except nerds like me who care are very annoyed by Gary Seven even existing. To me, he was basically a noncanon thing made by Roddenberry to try and use what little blood he thought Trek still had to jump to another show. It failed. And we ignored Gary Seven for years, but now we have him back in the prime timeline as something that’s real. Which means that episode where they’re just going into the fucking past for routine inspection.

We also find out that the Loom don’t just eat you, they erase you from existence. Any memories or thoughts of you, you are just ERASED from the timeline. Tysses and Majel beam down with a redshirt who is immediately eaten and erased horrifyingly. That’s SO fucked up. Tysses remembers him because he had a time displacer on him, so he figures out quickly what those things do. He tries to beam them up, but Majel stays behind to help her friends. Considering how she started this season as a hoighty toity shithead Vulcan, she changed REAL fast, and did it mostly because she’s crushing hardcore on the glowing orb.

Dal risks their lives to drop Majel into their hiding spot. She falls RIGHT into Zero’s arms, blushing as she realizes who’s holding her. Cute. They have to flee though, cause now the Loom know where they are.

But who comes to save the day? Fuckign Janeway. She fires phasers on the Loom, who just… ignore them and kill HALF her crew, erasing them from existence, again, horrifying. This is a kid’s show, that’s far worse than blood and gore IMO. But then she does THIS.

They knew the fucking assignment. As soon as Janeway puts on the tanktop and starts shit talking aliens killing her crew, you KNOW it’s over for them. She finds their phase variance and blasts them, getting them to chase her out of the ship. She crashes on the planet, still in her tanktop and a gun. GOD she’s hot. They knew EXACTLY what they were doing.

Wesley uses some time science magic to find a timelien where the six of them can solve this problem. He can’t find it. But when he accounts for Majel, he solves it. Also when they’re being scanned like this, they can see the future. He tells them all to close their eyes, Dal does not of course. And he realizes that he is not captian material. Seeing all these futures, he’s like “I don’t want these”. Bout time he realizes that.

Wesley sends them… somewhere. Then he sends Janeway back to her ship, and blows the planet up, disappearing. Welp, bye Wes.

The gang (and Majel, who is now part of the gang officially) land on a desert planet and find

NO.

NO.

ABSOLUTELY NOT.

YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO MAKE CHAKOTAY HOT.

I REJECT THIS ON A FUNDAMENTAL LEVEL.

entry.title: Muppet Show Watch-along Season 1 Part 2
entry.content:
My friends and I are watching the Muppet Show on Wednesdays and I guess I’ll do a quick review and watchalong. But first, I guess we should talk about the thing about watching the Muppets in the year of our Luigi 2026.

The Muppet Show is a beloved institution, and everyone loves it. So you’d think it’d be super easy to watch today, right? It is NOT. It’s been re-released a bunch of times, but due to the nature of what the Muppet Show IS, the re-releases keep shifting and cutting things all over the place. So if you want the FULL experience, it’s pretty impossible. But you can do your best.

ANOTHER thing is, what is the order? If you ask Wikipedia, you get a specific answer. If you ask the Muppets wiki, you get another. We’re just… gonna do our best to watch them all in whatever order we can, alright? At least it’s obvious where the seasons begin and end.

And finally… the whole point of the Muppet Show is about the human guest stars who star alongside the Muppets. These are all the most famous stars of the 70s, so I know like, MAYBE five of them. Obviously, I’m gonna like an episode that stars Vincent Price, who I love, a little more than one that stars Sandy Duncan, who I do not know at all. There might be some jokes and commentary about those guest stars I just flat out do not get. I’m doing my best, but this isn’t like, a retrospective. This is a nerd who grew up watching random Muppets content who wants to watch the Muppets Show and the only way she can really connect to media is if she orders and ranks it all or some shit. So yeah, let’s do that.

Episode 108: Paul Williams 7/10

This one starts with an interesting change: the intro is different! It’s been a little off this entire time, but now Kermit is in the logo and introduces the guest star, and all is right with the world.

I only really know Paul Williams because he’s the guy who wrote Rainbow Connection and I’ve seen pictures of him with the Muppets a lot. Kermit even calls him an honorary muppet. He kinda looks like Garth Merenghi.

They keep doing short jokes, which feels mean but he seems to be real into it.

This one is pretty alright. The throughline joke isn’t anything special, it’s just Fozzy trying to do new jokes with Scooter and failing. (He keeps pretending he’s a telephone pole) But it has a few fun firsts. First Muppet Labs, so the first Dr. Bunsen Honeydew sighting, but we also have our first sighting of Robin! Or well, who will become Robin.

Episode 109: Charles Aznavour 6.5/10

NO clue who this guy is, but he’s very French. A French songwriter, and French music doesn’t really cross over here too often. It’s…. pretty old fashioned music, too. Not BAD or anything. His first time on screen we also see a puppeteer puppeting someone for the first time…. dunno if it’s intentionally, it doesn’t SEEM to be, they just didn’t catch it. They’re usually really good with that.

The throughplot is that Gonzo is upset because Kermit isn’t putting him in the show anymore. He claims he has loads of fans waiting for him and his art. Kermit argues he has none. Well, AS a Gonzo fan, Kermit is wrong >:( He lists some of Gonzo’s art shows, and one of them is “eating a tire to music”. If I saw someone eat a tire to music, I would be ENTHRALLED.

Unfortunately, this DOES eventually conclude with a crossdressing joke.

EXTREMELY good Piggy scene here. Charles explains to Kermit that women just get horny at French, even if they don’t get it, and after whispering nonsense into Ms Piggy’s ears, she makes out with him. “Oh, Charles, I’m so sorry.” “Why? I just met the girl of my dreams.” Charles, you are so right.

Episode 110: Harvey Korman 7/10

Oh hey, it’s Hedy! “That’s HEDLEY.”

It’s interesting to actually know one of these people. We’re introduced to him doing an animal tamer act against the truly evil monstrous demon, Thog. Thog is a sweetie who wouldn’t hurt a fly. I love him. He’s into Balzac!

Another gag here that made me giggle was in the At The Dance segment, a balloon muppet explodes. Everyone treats it as horrifying but it made me laugh. How fucked up am I, huh?

Lots of Electric Mayhem numbers in this one. Mostly cause they had to put in the UK Spot, which is an itneresting thing, I dunno if I mentioned that. In the UK, commercials ended sooner so they needed a longer show, just slightly. So they usually just put in a cover of some music, cause that was easier for them to do.

Have an out of context image of Hedy in a chicken outfit. “How do I get outta this chicken shit outfit?”

We also get a song with Robin. I like Robin, but every single time he’s on screen, it’s like he’s a dickensian orphan who is in the process of dying of consumption. Like he’s struggling to even get through his lines.

Episode 111: Lena Horne 6/10

Honestly this one was just alright. Lena Horne is fine, I like her, and I did like the gag where Fozzy didn’t recognize her and she pretends to be someone random. But nothing else here really stands out.

I guess I also like the Swedish Chef segment but I ALWAYS like the Swedish Chef segments. There’s nothing WRONG with this episode but there’s nothing that stands out.

Okay I stand corrected. Right at the end Lena does a rendition of “Sing” from Sesame Street, and I really love that song.

Episode 112: Peter Ustinov 9/10

One of the things I like with the Muppets is when very serious actors have to “step down” to the Muppets level. And you can see very classically trained actors who have to basically BE Muppets for some, and it’s fantastic.

He and Fozzy tell a shaggy dog pun. It’s perfect. We all went “Jesus CHRIST” at the punchline. I also love this cause like, is this what the British think Americans are like? …They’re kinda right.

The throughline story here is that Kermit is jealous of Peter. Everyone keeps saying he’s great at things they said Kermit was great for. When Kermit points out they said he was good, they go “Oh I was wrong”. And this culminates in…

It sure isn’t easy bein’ green. Classic for a reason.

Episode 113: Bruce Forsyth 8/10

This one starts off strong with some cute Snerfs dancing around and tooting to “In a Little Spanish Town”. Very fitting of some Snerfs, whatever they are. I love them, they’re perfect little creatures.

The running joke here is Fozzy is trying to get better at handling heckers, and he’s practicing with Kermit. First he begs Kermit to stop. Then he smacks Kermit with a rubber chicken. But it’s okay, cause he won’t be heckled! Because Bruce goes out instead.

For his standup routine, he heckles back at Statler and Waldorf. “Ohhh, he’s burying me, he’s burying me!” It’s good to see them get their comeuppance. Eventually, Fozzie comes out and Bruce gives him some technique for fighting hecklers. He goes a little hard.

This was a good one, some good gags.

Episode 114: Sandy Duncan 7.5/10

This may feel reductive but I feel like every one of these white women the Muppets Show has on in the 70s look exactly the same.

Though I DO like her in this first skit lookin’ like a prince character from a yuri manga.

The throughline joke for this one is that Fozzie got a new writer, “Gags Beasley”, who wrote the famous Banana Sketch. And get this, KERMIT doesn’t know it! The famous banana sketch! Of course I don’t need to tell you what it is, because we’ve all seen it. This one was fun.

Episode 115: Candice Bergen 7.5/10

It feels like Ms Piggy has gotten like, higher res? She’s showing up more nad more instead of just a oneshot with a weird off brand voice.

I dunno Candice Bergen, but there’s a good bit where she’s in a scene with some hillbilly muppet and he sings some misogynist nonsense, so she gets dressed in a feminist outfit, destroys the house, and menaces him with a shotgun. My kinda woman!

The throughline gag of this episode is Fozzy is tortuing poor Kermit with a repeat of the same joke over and over. “Wire for Kermit the Frog! Are you Kermit the frog?” “Yes, Fozzie, you know it’s me.” “Here you go!” And then he hangs a wire hanger on him. Cute. This culminates in Kermit trying to get back at him by shoving a pie in his face, and he gets some on poor Candice. The entire scene screams “that was an accident” and we’re seeing them riff, and it’s VERY funny. Candice looks like she’s gonna fall over laughing.

Episode 116: Avery Schreiber 7.5/10

Avery is a fun over the top comedian, so PERFECT for playing around with the Muppets. He’s basically a Muppet tbh. Especially with the throughline being Miss Piggy trying to claim Avery is into her to make Kermit jealous. At first it’s just to make him jealous but I think Avery is super into it.

Honestly Avery’s skits in general are good. He gets into an insult match with Sweetums, and the insults they throw at each other are fun. Honestly, Avery is the main reason to watch this episode, nothing else really beats him and his skits.

entry.title: LizstarTrek - Picard Season 3 episodes 6 - 10
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

Okay, y’all remember Picard season 1 and 2? What’s that? You DON’T, cause they were BAD? Well don’t worry, the people who made this season didn’t remember them either, so they just don’t fucking matter! Moving RIGHT ALONG!

The Bounty - PIC 8/10

bouncer voice The BOUNTY.

Vadic yells at her underlings and goes “TELL ME YOU HAVE FOUND PICARD.” What. She’s not after Picard? He’s like, third in command of that ship, he’s not important to her. Unless she means his son, but his son is NOT named Picard. You just needed that scene for the trailers, didn’t you

Anyways they finally scan Jack and find out he has something called Irumodic Syndrone, something that Picard has. This is the thing he was dying of in season 1. It’s apparently hitting Jack WAY earlier. Jack is not taking this well, and is panicking about having a lethal condition. It’s called being alive dude.

I gotta say… Worf’s actor, Michael Dorn? He looks fucking fantastic. Honestly if they didn’t put a bunch of white shit in his hair I’d be confused why he hasn’t aged at all since the 90s. All these crackers surrounding him are old as shit now and are wrinkled old fucks, but black don’t crack, and you can fucking tell looking at Michael Dorn.

This man is in his 70s.

Worm, Riker, and Raffi need to sneak into the Daystrom institute and steal some shit. They drop them off, but then Federation ships show up and they gotta run away. Apparently they’re tracking them. The away team is on their own in the Daystrom institute with no way of escape in case they find out they’re there.

They go into the institute and into a restricted wing that contains a lot of stuff Section 31 is keeping under lock and key. It’s basically the “top men” warehouse but for Star Trek. It has Genesis, Jame Kirk’s corpse, evil tribbles. Riker is NOT getting along well with Worf. He does his joking stuff at him and Worf calls him out. “You used to poke back? What the hell happened to you?!” Worf is basically a pacifist now, and Riker is like “I just don’t understand the world anymore.”

You know what ELSE they’re keeping in there?

Professor Moriarity. I honestly do like modern Trek’s willingness to clean up loose ends and characters. I think some people are unhappy about this, but like, I’m into it.

They go and get Geordi’s help. Geordi isn’t SUPER happy about this. He’s actually been working against all the unsafe shit the Changelings have been pushing forward for a while. Things like “getting all the fleet together in one place” and “connecting the ships so they can talk to each other”. Cause of that he probably can’t actually help them. The fleet is both too secure AND too unsecure. There’s also stuff there about being unhappy his daughter joined Star Fleet.

They for some reason solve Moriarity’s “puzzle”? By calling back to the first episode and having Riker whistle? I don’t fully get it. But Moriarity disappears, and they find… DATA. This entire scene confounded me.

This season does less of it but it DOES still have some of the “guy says something he thinks is profound but is a little dumb in the moment and out of context and confusing”. Jack does this to Seven. She fucking calls him out of it. Good shit.

We also get scenes with Geordi and his daughter. He wants her to stay with him so he can protect her, but she’s like “fuck that, we need to save people”. Calling him out on it. Hell yea.

Remember Altan Soong? He died off screen, I think, but used his last time to try and make a new Data, using parts of him, parts of Lal, parts of Lore and B-4. He died before he could fully finish it. But he’s fully connected to their systems and is running the AI of the institute. He sees everything, and when he saw them he kind of glitched out.

Jack steals the cloaking device from the Bounty, the bird of prey from Trek 4. lol. lmao. Geordi finally gets off his ass and joins the team, helping stabilize the cloaking device. He also tells Jack to stay the hell away from his daughter, cause that’s apparently a thing that’s going on.

They go and rescue the away team… mostly. Riker is left behind, clearing the way for them, but they take Data instead. The crew is… basically fully here. We’re just missing Troi. and Riker, now.

For five seconds, then Worf leaves to go rescue Riker.

They wake Data up and he’s KIND of Data. He describes it as a collection of voices. He’s also glitching weirdly. But he DOES tell them what the Changelings stole from Daystrom. Picard’s corpse. And then we see Riker getting captured from being captured by Vadic, aaaand she has someone else with her! Troi is here. Hey, the gang IS all here finally!

This was mostly pretty good, VERY nostalgia baity. But I don’t mind some of that tbh.

Dominion - PIC 6.5/10

They are trying to find any allies they can. Seven reaches out to one of her last allies she can find. Captain Tuvok. But… It’s not Tuvok ): Seven gets him in a trick, and they break the link. They’re on their own.

It feels like every other scene has something they made specifically for the trailers. They can’t ALL the lines they made for the trailers, so maybe they just…. wrote it like this? It’s distracting?

Data is swapping between Data and Lore at the drop of a hat. Ahhh, Brent Spiner, I did miss you. Data does NOT like this sharing a body thing.

We get some scenes of Vadic talking to this weird meat face. It is NOT a Changeling, but some other outside force. Please be some kind of GOOD twist.

Things are bad, but they find out where Riker is. They just need to get Vadic to come to them…. How do they do that? By using Jack as bait. Vadic does, in fact, IMMEDIATELY come running.

The trap works perfectly. They capture Vadic, Jack is safe, aaand- whoops, Lore gets out and takes over the ship. I’m sure that won’t be bad.

Before we get to THAT though, we get Crusher interrogating Vadic. Vadic finds it kind of cute. She is a VERY entertaining villain. She’s not exactly working with them and telling them everything, but she’s willing to at least talk to them. She calls out the Federation on a few things. 1) Genocide, which yes, they did kinda jump to that in the Dominion War (well, Section 31 did). Of course she says they only started the war cause the solids would be the kind to jump to Genocide so like, it’s a self fulfilling nonsense there. She also 2) says Starfleet gave them the ability to mimic blood. So, Federation science experiments. They basically kidnapped Changeling kids and mutated them into things to become perfect spies.

Lore gets full control and lets down the forcefields. Geordi keeps trying to do a “I know you can hear me” thing, but it doesn’t really work. For some reason Jack can like, mind communicate and connect with Sidney, Geordi’s daughter, and gets her out of a dangerous situation, saving her life. Geordi also gets through to Data but uh, it’s too late. Vadic takes the bridge.

Surrender - PIC 7.5/10

Vadic begins massacring crew members. She broadcasts their screams over the intercom. What a sicko, I love her. She could make me worse.

lmao there’s a good scene with Riker and Troi. “You should know, the Changeling came to our home pretending to be you.” “Oh yeah? What was he like?” “Good at sex, bad at pizza.” “Oh, like me!” I love them too.

Jack admits he can take over people’s bodies and reach into their minds. Crusher IMMEDIATELY scans him like “wtf” and finds nothing. Still no clue wtf this is about, but okay.

Jack tries to take the ship back by sneaking into a body of someone on the bridge and implementing Picard’s override. Vadic finds out, and immediately knows it must be Jack taking over people’s bodies. Vadic kills one of the bridge crew as a punishment. Goodbye, T’Veen, the bald vulcan. You had a few voice lines! I guess we’re not gonna see her kill Seven like this.

Worf FINALLY shows back up and rescues Riker and Troi. He also makes some weird comments to Troi. Riker basically gags. Oh yeah, they DID have a thing for a minute didn’t they. Also hey. Where’s Raffi? She just… disappeared off the face of the planet. I thought maybe she was with Worf but she’s not here, so… Okay THERE she is, like two scenes later. Practically written out of the show.

Lots of things happen at once. They try and help Data defeat Lore in his mind. While Jack goes to the bridge carrying fucking bombs in order to get them to stop killing people. Vadic accepts, sending away all the surviving bridge crew… except for Seven, who jumps out to stay behind for… some reason. Vadic keeps HINTING at wtf is going on with Jack. And I do want to note that when Jack walks into the bridge, he does it by saying “it’s impossible to resist”. One might say it’s futile, actually.

So basically, in the battle in Data’s mind, Data has just been giving up and handing all of his memories to Lore. By doing this he basically corrupted Lore from the inside out, taking the thing that were Data and thus turning him into Data. They combine into one being.

“Greetings Titan. This is your friendly, pissed off security system, back on line” What a WILD Data line. Data rehacks the ship IMMEDIATELY and takes everything back over. Vadic is fucking spaced, of course, we needed that quota. Vadic freezes outside and shatters against her ship, exploding. Uh, rip I guess. I’ll miss her, she was fun. Her last words are “fucking solids”, which is funny. They then blow up her ship… instead of taking it. What? It’s a fucking gun with a warp core. Steal that shit, they were all dead anyway.

There’s a sweet scene with Geordi and Data. They reconnect with their friendship. Cute.

Troi has a psychic counselor session with Jack. Together, they go into his mindscape and open the weird red door that’s been constantly flashed on screen. But nope, we don’t get to figure out what THAT is because lol the end of the episode.

Honestly the only major problems with this season is its pacing is bad. That’s it, the rest has been pretty good.

Võx - PIC 7.5/10

Troi finally opens that god damn door. She immediately breaks the connection as she does, running away freaking out, as Jack panics. “What did you see?!” That’s not a very good way to counsel, counselor Troi. Anyways what did she see? She saw a Borg cube and heard the collective.

MORE.

FUCKING.

BORG.

This is the THIRD SEASON of Picard to be about Picard having once been Locutus.

Apparently because Picard was Locutus once, his son (and possibly his organic body?) has organic recievers that allow him to do Borg stuff but with biology, no technology. It’s a little stupid, honestly? Jack doesn’t really take this well. ESPECIALLY considering they all decide immediately to lock him up in “a research station” on Vulcan. They’re just following “Starfleet Protocols”.

Being abandoned by everyone he loves causes him to turn to the dark side. He takes over bodies to escape. Wow, Picard, you are a SHITTY father. And a TERRIBLE NEGOTIATOR. I think that’s the point though? Like, he fucks up, REAL bad here. I guess cause his own fears of his past and what he’s done get the better of him? Dude we’ve had like two whole seasons about you getting over this, and other TNG episodes too!!

Well thats a problem for later. Frontier Day is happening! That’s the big celebration where all the ships are together for one thing. The lady who was trying to take Riker’s job in Best of Both Worlds is now an admiral and is overseeing it. Damn, she hopped over Riker, huh?? We also learn SHE’S the one who’s pushing the synchronization of all the ships. “The irony of HER doing something so borg like…”

Isn’t this something that bit them in the ass in both Prodigy AND Lower Decks? Those canonically happened before this. When will Starfleet learn??

Jack is immediately taken by the Queen and assimilated :) Great.

Okay, we learn Picard was actually a “reciever”, and his son is the speaker. He biologically can listen and recieve commands from Jack. And they’ve made this DNA code the genetic base in all transporter systems so now ANYONE who uses a Federation transporter will have this DNA code and not even know it. Also for some reason it will affect kids but not adults. Okay, weird.

This means that all the kids are now assimilated. Oh boy!! They IMMEDIATELY kill Shelbey, fucking rip her. “Only stun them!” says Picard. OH NOW IT’S FINE TO STUN THEM BECAUSE MAYBE THEY CAN BE UNASSIMILATED. YOU’RE NOT GONNA FUCKING MOW THEM DOWN WITH A TOMMY GUN????

“ATTENTION. YOUR ARMADA HAS BEEN ADDED TO OUR OWN.” What do you mean by that? They’re not glowing green???

“Data, could you TRY being a little more positive?” “I hope we die quickly! :)” I missed you, Data.

Some of them escape. Some do not. Captain Shaw is shot and killed. Before he dies, he gives the conn to Seven AND calls her Seven. Finally got that character growth, it just took him his fucking death. Raffi and Seven stay behind while all of the TNG crew blast off in a shuttle.

They make it back to Geordi’s museum and he shows a project he’s been working on for a while. The Enterprise D. Finally here. Damn, she sure does look ugly in wide screen. They also say something happened to the E. No clue. It’s left to Spaghetti Incident.

Is this nostalgia bait? It sure is. Do I care? Not really. This is exactly what ANYONE who wanted a Picard show would want. Shit, we even get Majel Barret’s voice over the comm as the computer! EVERYONE IS HERE. EVERY SINGLE CHARACTER. EVEN THE SHIP.

….Except O’Brien. He’s off cleaning a holodeck somewhere. (I mean HOPEFULLY the man is retired and building ships in a bottles or something)

Off they go. Engage.

Pretty good nostalgia bait, but I can’t get over Picard being a fucking idiot causing the entire first 8 episodes to basically be a moot point and just GIVING Jack to the Borg.

The Last Generation - PIC 8.5/10

We get “Antov Chekov”, Chekov’s son, actually voiced by Walter Koenig, being like “DO NOT APPROACH EARTH”.

They approach the Borg Cube, which is hidden inside the giant storm of Jupiter. They just built a fucking transwarp gate in Jupiter. How the hell did they pull this off with no one noticing? Does no one look at Jupiter anymore? “Dude, we studied that planet YEARS ago, we don’t look at that old thing anymore.”

Anyways, back on the Titan, Raffi and Seven storm the fucking bridge, guns blazing. They are hot as shit. They also teleport them off the bridge into the locked teleport station using some shenanigans. The borg then bang on the door like fucking zombies. They’re still zombies. THEY’RE STILL JUST FUCKING ZOMBIES. STOP MAKING THE BORG ZOMBIES. THEY ARE NOT ZOMBIES.

STOP.

The party splits. Riker, Picard, and Worf beam down into the Borg Cube to find the transciever and blow it up. The rest stay on the ship to help where they can.

On the cube they find drones of various states of decomposition. All deceased, their bodies and tissues being consumed by the systems to feed something.

They split up AGAIN, this time Riker and Worf go to find the transciever, while Picard goes to find his son.

Jack is now Vox, and is broadcasting the usual “Your distinctiveness will be added to the whole” thing but he also adds a lot to it? “We will bring peace to the galaxy. We will cleanse disease and death.” The Borg are trying to rebrand!!

The Borg Queen is here, MY FAVORITE CHARACTER, OH FUCKING BOY. Damn girl, you live like this??? Future Janeway sure did do a fucking number on you, huh???

She’s like “I’M DOING THIS IN REVENGE FOR YOUR PEOPLE POISONING US AND LEAVING US TO DIE ON THE EDGE OF SPACE.” Bitch, you did that yourself. You could have EASILY just let Janeway go, and it would have been fine. This is ALL you being a greedy fucking weirdo. I hate the Borg Queen. I still hate the Borg Queen. I always have hated the Borg Queen, and I always will. But at least she hasn’t changed. She’s still awful. She’s been devouring what little of her collective still exists to sustain just herself, you know, like a fucking collective??? The Borg Queen has always been a dumb fucking thing. I hate it. I hate her. I HATE it. I hate it as much as the Borg being zombies.

“We have gone past assimilation. Now we’re into evolution. We are biological borg THAT CAN FUCK. WE DO NOT NEED TO TAKE OVER OTHERS.”

Also the Borg Cube is so fucking dark. Why is Modern Trek SO FUCKING DARK.

The Enterprise D is so bright, thankfully.

Data pilots the Enterprise INTO the Borg Cube, using his super powers to just go through the borg cube’s defenses to blow up the tranciever at the heart of the cube. Picard keeps trying to go “YOU’RE IN THERE!” while Jack is demonstrably not in there and is just locking targets on every city on Earth.

So in order to reach him… he just fucking re-assimilates himself. Which is apparently as easy as stabbing your neck with some old pipe. He has like, a minute to convince Jack inside the collective to get out, because the Enterprise is firing on the transciever and when it explodes, it blows up the entire Cube.

What convinces Jack to get out? An awkward hug from his dad. Oh also I guess Picard is like “Well I’ll just stay here and die with you then, no biggie.” I dunno if it hits QUITE as hard as they want it to, but it’s not bad tbh. Jack rips himself out of the wires and grabs his father as the Borg Queen grimaces and scowls like “NOOO, NOOOO, WHERE DID I GO WRONG? HOW DID I FAIL?!” like she always does every fucking time she fails, which she always does, because she’s fucking stupid and I hate her.

And then, one more fuck you to Rick Berman. Troi uses her powers to find out where they are and get a teleporter lock on them. Troi saves the day. Troi does something.

The Borg Queen dies in fire. Good riddance.

For some reason the sudden end of the Borg Cube causes the weird Borg Lines on everyone to go away.

We then get some weird scenes of them like, staring at each other, smiling and nodding. And Worf falls asleep in his chair cause he’s old. It’s a weird tone shift.

We get a “where are they now”. Crusher becomes medical lead in Starfleet and develops a cure for the Borg and a way to scan for Changelings. Seven tries to resign because she assumed she’s being fired anyway cause of everything she did. But a last minute log by her dead captain convinces her otherwise, saying she deserves captaincy. Tuvok promotes her. Gee, he was secretly a nice guy all along, if only he had told us.

Worf leaked Raffi’s commodations and everything she did. Her son now wants to see her and wants her to meet her grandkid. “Whoever did this is an honorable maverick”. I bet, Worf. I liked the Raffi and Worf stuff this season, it was quite good but I do wish it wasn’t pushed into the background quite as much.

Tell me about it, Data.

Data is getting counseling from Data to understand his new emotions, as Troi and Riker have fully reconnected after their son’s death. And the Enterprise went back to the museum, to be shown off, and be taken good care of. “After all, she’s always taken good care of us.”

And Jack has his first posting, he’s being put on the Titan. Though it’s been renamed now. It’s now the “Enterprise G”, with captain Seven of Nine leading the way, and her girlfriend as her number one. It’s honestly nuts. They’re DATING. They’re STILL DATING. THAT IS DANGEROUS, DON’T PUT THEM ON THE SAME SHIP? And for some reason Jack’s position is “special counselor to the captain”, dunno what that means.

It does one of those teases of “Every captain has their ‘let’s go to warp’ statement’, what’s your’s?” and she opens her mouth as it cuts off. That’s great, I like that.

Then all the old fucks are at the bar with a toast. Data tries to tell a limerick, and they shut him up. Poor guy. And then they pay some poker. Cute. Good way to end their story, honestly, the same way they ended it the first time.

Oh hey there’s a post credits sequence.

Hello Q. “I thought you died” “You don’t need to think so linearly.” Cute hook that nothing has happened with, but who knows maybe eventually

Anyways mostly good season. Nothing AMAZING in it but its certainly worth watching. Basically what you’d want from a TNG sequel series. I WOULD have loved more DS9 rep, but we at least got Seven and a Tuvok reference, right?

entry.title: Muppet Show Watch-along Season 1 Part 1
entry.content:
My friends and I are watching the Muppet Show on Wednesdays and I guess I’ll do a quick review and watchalong. But first, I guess we should talk about the thing about watching the Muppets in the year of our Luigi 2026.

The Muppet Show is a beloved institution, and everyone loves it. So you’d think it’d be super easy to watch today, right? It is NOT. It’s been re-released a bunch of times, but due to the nature of what the Muppet Show IS, the re-releases keep shifting and cutting things all over the place. So if you want the FULL experience, it’s pretty impossible. But you can do your best.

ANOTHER thing is, what is the order? If you ask Wikipedia, you get a specific answer. If you ask the Muppets wiki, you get another. We’re just… gonna do our best to watch them all in whatever order we can, alright? At least it’s obvious where the seasons begin and end.

And finally… the whole point of the Muppet Show is about the human guest stars who star alongside the Muppets. These are all the most famous stars of the 70s, so I know like, MAYBE five of them. Obviously, I’m gonna like an episode that stars Vincent Price, who I love, a little more than one that stars Sandy Duncan, who I do not know at all. There might be some jokes and commentary about those guest stars I just flat out do not get. I’m doing my best, but this isn’t like, a retrospective. This is a nerd who grew up watching random Muppets content who wants to watch the Muppets Show and the only way she can really connect to media is if she orders and ranks it all or some shit. So yeah, let’s do that.

Episode 101: Juliet Prowse 8/10

This one starts off real strong, with Mah Na Mah Na, one of the most beloved and well known musical numbers from the Muppets history. Did you know that it was originally from an Italian movie, and this rendition of it is what made it actually well known? Yes, in the movie Sweden: Heaven and Hell, the song “Mah Na Mah Na” plays over a scene of lesbians in a sauna. Yes. Mah Na Mah Nah is lesbian culture.

Beyond the classic that is Mah Na Mah Na, we have some good jokes and skits and a good throughline of Scooter’s famous uncle’s dog wanting to be top billing and annoying poor Kermit. Here’s an image of Kermit drinking milk. Way better than tea Kermit.

Now, I don’t really know who Juliet Prowse is, but she’s pretty good here. She’s a dancer, and we do get some dancing scenes. I’m not really into dancing. But she has some scenes where she flirts with Kermit and gives him a kiss. Lucky Juliet.

The weirdest thing about this episode is beta Ms Piggy, but its a good one.

Episode 102: Connie Stevens 6.5/10

This one doesn’t start quiiite as well, with Kermit singing to a tattooed pig who is kind of horrifying. And Kermit, of course, isn’t the beeeest singer. At least Ms. Piggy punches him after.

As someone who only watched SOME Muppets Show as a kid, and mostly watched the movies and specials, there’s lots of weird things in season 1. Like Hilda, who just stopped existing after this season ended.

She looks like that meat worm you sometimes see in memes.

I dunno who Connie Stevens is, some pop singer from the time, but she sings a rendition of “Teenager In Love” with “The Mutations” and it’s pretty good. They do a “Close to You” cover too with her serenading both Kermit AND Fozzy. Holy shit Connie, leave some for the rest of us.

She’s a fine enough guest but they also got the REAL guests, Ernie and Bert from Sesame Street!

Noseless Bert is real and he can hurt you.

The throughline for this one is Gonzo has a ratty old bear stuffy that he loves and wants to keep, and everyone else tells him it sucks ass. Fozzy keeps mishearing it and thinking they’re about him. It’s alright, I do love Fozzy, but this is just an okay throughline.

Episode 103: Joel Grey 5.5/10

This one is fine. The jokes and skits are fine, nothing super standout or interesting.

The guest this time is Joel Grey, who I also don’t know, but I know he was in Cabaret, and they do, in fact, just do Wilkommen from Cabaret. But with Muppets. I’m honestly surprised they got away with just doing Cabaret with the Cabaret guy, that’s great.

The throughline gag here is that Fozzy is too self obsessed and is doing a new act where someone says something and he does a standup line about it off the cuff, so people keep telling him to stop or asking him to do something and he just goes into an act and annoys them. Not really interesting. At least the payoff is good with Statler and Waldorf stumping him.

It’s ended with another classic musical number, with Joel teaching Gonzo about the ol’ Razzle Dazzle. I don’t dislike any of this, but for some reason none of this really sticks with me. I’m not really a musical person.

Episode 104: Ruth Buzzi 6.5/10

This one has some alright bits. The throughline gag is that there’s a windup frog gifted by Scooter’s uncle that harasses poor Kermit the entire time. They even do the ol’ mirror bit, a good bit.

Ruth Buzzi was a lot of things, but especially a comedian, so while a lot of the other women guest stars don’t really do much more than go up and sing or dance, Ruth goes WILD, doing prat falls in a duet with Sweetums. She’s a pretty good guest, and she’s clearly having loads of fun being here.

Other than her though, there’s nothing here super standout.

Episode 105: Rita Moreno 10/10

Now THIS is what I’m talkin’ about! Rita is fantastic here, I love all of her skits. The one where she’s dancing with a muppet that she just fucking tosses around is so funny. Not to mention her section in the panel discussion, where she just threatens Miss Piggy in Spanish. She’s perfect. I love her. And it’s not JUST her that stands out in this episode, of course.

We’ve got the first Veterinarian’s Hospital, with Dr. Bob “taking care” of Fozzy. The jokes are actually pretty good. The throughline gag here is Fozzy answering the phone, weird things coming out, and he says who it was. Like, water pours oh, “it’s the water department.” Simple, cute, funny.

And the Swedish Chef gag! God I love Swedish Chef. Basically all of these skits are bangers actually. This isn’t the first Chef gag, but it is the 2nd, and a very good one. There’s lots of other firsts here though. We’ve got the first Muppaphone, the first Country Trio. But everything is just leading up to the very important finale.

Rita tries to do a rendition of “Fever” but it’s occasionally ruined by Animal’s drumming and sassing. She sasses RIGHT back, and it’s fantaaastic. It ends with her slamming Animal between two cymbals, as he goes “DAT MY KINDA WOMAN”. Hell yeah it is.

Episode 106: Jim Nabors 6/10

This one shows a problem with the weird episode ordering problem. Scooter is hired and introduced in this episode, even though he’s been in a lot of the previous ones. It doesn’t really matter much, but it’s a LITTLE annoying. THat’s the throughline gag here, Scooter is a big of a mess but Kermit does whatever he wants just because he’s the owner’s nephew. I think Scooter works much better as an occasional gag character rather than being like 40% of the gags.

Jim Nabors is alright here. He’s got a few good skits and gags but for the most part I feel he doesn’t quite fit in. He’s kinda goin’ hard on that “just an ol’ country boy” energy, but also doing like, opera, it’s kinda a weird combination. It’s not that he’s BAD or anything, but I don’t really love his songs. Some of his jokes and gags are good though.

….I don’t have much more to say about this one! It’s fine.

Episode 106: Florence Henderson 6/10

This one takes a bit to get going. It’s fine, nothing special, but I like the talk spot. We get some early Miss Piggy stuff, with her being all over Kermit. And Florence tries to help Miss Piggy get with Kermit. It fails. This is the first HIIIIYAH! we hear. The runninbg gag here is just all about Miss Piggy… I think. She shows up a lot. Is that a running gag? A minor character showing up a lot?

Florence is fine here. Nothing super breathtaking, but she’s fun and gets kinda into it at points. I like her singing alongside a bunch of random muppets who are super into her. I’m into the Florence and Random Monsters Polycule.

It goes a bit down though when it gets to the talk segment and seems to make jokes about slurs? It’s not uh, very good. Though it DOES have Miss Piggy say “PIGS OF THE WORLD, UNITE!” Shout outs to communist Miss Piggy.

entry.title: LizstarTrek - Picard Season 3 episodes 1 - 5
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

Okay, y’all remember Picard season 1 and 2? What’s that? You DON’T, cause they were BAD? Well don’t worry, the people who made this season didn’t remember them either, so they just don’t fucking matter! Moving RIGHT ALONG!

Two of One - PIC 7/10

We start up with some Ink Spots, a good banger as always, and then suddenly BOOM, GATES MCFADDEN! She says someone “found them”, and she looks A) SO FUCKING GOOD and B) has a fucking gun. That’s what I’d want from a modern Crusher, for sure.

She is injured in the fight, more are on the way, and she sends a distress message to Picard specifically.

Well Picard is doing what he does best. Sitting in a chair and talking to the Romulan he will never mack on even though he should have two seasons ago. He’s talking about how he’s ready to just sit back, write his memoirs, and doesn’t need some kind of legacy, he’s feeling pretty chill these days.

For some reason he spends a scene talking to the computer like it’s chatgpt and getting frustrated at how it’s a shitty hunk of junk that can’t actually understand what he’s asking it or what he wants. How did this shit get worse in the past 30 years? Damn, we get rid of Majel Barret and now we have This. Anyways, he finds the message from Crusher and she says “Hellbird. No starfleet. Sending these coordinates. Trust no one.”

Picard’s Romulan girlfriend sends him off. He’s like “oh this’ll be done in a few days I’m sure”. Aight buddy. HOLY SHIT, THEY KISSED. I bet this is the last time we see her, what do you wanna bet? Apparently Crusher just disappeared and wouldn’t talk to anyone for the past decade or two, so they have no idea what’s going on with her.

He forgoes the “trust no one” statement and goes to Riker but I mean, if we can’t trust Riker who CAN we trust? What about Picard’s new crew of Seven and- nope, forget them. Riker. I mean, that’s what I woulda done, frankly. Riker takes the code words Bev sent them and determines the actual place they need to go, and off they go… as someone watches and tails them.

Okay actually apparently some of his new crew IS here. Raffi is… back on her drug habits and is struggling. She’s back out of Starfleet. Who the hell knows. Why do they keep doing this to this poor fucking woman??? Okay no, she’s just gathering info for Starfleet intelligence. Well that’s good, at least. AND she doesn’t actually take the narcotics she bought! Good, let’s not just throw her fucking character development out AGAIN. Anyways she’s hunting for some secret weapon that was stolen by a “red lady”.

Anyways, Riker and Picard come up with some hairbrained plan to con the captain of the new Titan to sneak them outside of Starfleet space to these coordinates. Seven of Nine is the 1st officer, somehow??? How long after season 2 is- oh right, THAT DOESN’T FUCKING MATTER. Also the captain refuses to call her Seven, so she’s Annika Hanson for now. Also the pilot of the ship they’re on is Geordi’s daughter, Sidney La Forge. Also known as “Crash” La Forge because as a cadet she crashed a shuttle, twice. Poor girl.

They meet the captain, Captain Shaw. He is a no nonsense guy who expects that they will find the ship very boring, because he runs it so well, and this routine inspection will be no problem at all. Ohhh this ship is gonna crash land, isn’t it. Anyways Shaw is an unlikable shithead.

Seven and Raffi are both struggling really hard. Raffi with relapses and the anxiety of fucking up and people dying, and Seven cause she has to deal with Shaw being a fuckhead. Neither feels this is where they should be, but people keep pushing them to do this and be here, so lol. Anyways Seven helps them get to the Ryton system and steal a shuttle, possibly at risk to her own career. Which of course, considering how vindictive and shitty Shaw is, he will 100% kill her career because she decided to help people out trying to do something to help someone when he didn’t want them do cause HE’S in charge. That kinda captain. Look, obviously Starfleet isn’t perfect, and sure we should show Starfleet people being awful sometimes, but I’m a LITTLE tired of it.

Anyways Raffi catches wind of what’s gonna happen, and tries to warn Starfleet HQ of a terrorist attack, whiiiich goes through and kills a LOT of people.

Anyways enough about that. Picard and Riker find Bev’s ship and go on board, and meet HER SON, who is for some reason British. And obviously he’s Picard’s son, right? Cause that ain’t no Wesley. And then a big evil arbiter ship from Star Craft shows up and toots at them for some reason, like all evil Star Trek ships do.

Two of One - PIC 4/10

Jack Crusher recounts the recent nonsense he and his mother have been through, hounded by a bunch of different people. First ranger, then Klingons. Their only plan now is to get Bev onto their shuttle and get her back to the Titan for medical help. Unfortunately, Shaw hasn’t become a better person in the past 10 minutes, so he still has no plans to actually help them in any way.

117 people died in the terrorist attack, and Raffi is VERY unhappy. Her handler is some shitty AI who is harassing her and ignoring her obvious distress. It tells her to stop, but she’s going to investigate who did this and make sure those people get some kind of closure, because Starfleet SEEMS to be doing nothing. This entire episode is Starfleet command just… ignoring people in need and doing nothing!

Okay I will say, terrorist attacks are a very common theme in modern Trek which has gotten VERY exhausting. Alongside the “The people in command are bad and will not help you”. Like I don’t DISAGREE with that but Star Trek can and should be better than our modern world.

Seven strokes Shaw’s ego and is like “You COULD be the guy who saved two heroes, OR the guy who let them die”. That’s all it takes.

The enemy ship contacts them. Their captain is Vadic, who is played by the daughter of the guy who played the bad guy in Star Trek 6, which should tell you what they were going for when they made this character. Anyways Vadic has no interest in ANYTHING other than getting Jack Crusher, and fully offers for them to go about their merry way if they deliver him in an hour, otherwise she’ll blow them the fuck up, and to show she means business, she just chucks Bev’s ship at them.

Seven is dismissed for insubordination, Shaw is still a dickhead, and Picard has 30 minutes to figure out what this guy’s deal is, and why this bounty hunter loaded to the nines with weapons wants him dead. He seems to be a petty criminal, one who claims he’s a doctor “doing good in a world that hates those who do good”.

Meanwhile Raffi is trying to get info in a seedy underbelly when she digs a bit too deep and a gang lord orders her dead. Instead of her being killed, the ganglord is suddenly fucking decapitated by WORF SHOWING UP OUT OF NOWHERE. Surprise Worf.

They’re going to give over Jack, but Jack basically lets himself out and tries to teleport over instead, thinking they won’t and that it might get his mother killed. But once Picard sees Beverly, standing there almost crying, he’s like “Alright fuck that I’m using my admiral powers to take over. We’re going to fight them.” This, of course, will NOT go well because they’re in an exploration vessel facing off against A Nuke With Guns, but hey, I’m sure it’ll be fine. Vadic seems to relish the hunt anyway.

Seventeen Seconds - PIC 5/10

I do not choose which images are the main images for an episode, but this one is lousy. It’s just Picard standing there looking old. Let the man rest.

They outrun Vadic, but for how long?

We get a flashback to CGI’d Riker and Picard looking a little younger. It not… as bad as it could be, but I hate it on principle. Just lather shit on em. Anyways, it’s Riker telling the story of his son’s birth, how it took him 17 seconds to get to sickbay, and the entire 17 seconds all those feelings he had. This is an episode about being a father, are you surprised?

Yes, so obviously, Picard is Jack’s father. Beverly tries to defend her reasons for just dipping and not telling him by being like “you were always going to be in danger and it’d hurt him too” and Picard is like “He’s my son too, I had a right to the choice!” it feels like… the opposite of the Zootopia abortion meme.

Also for some fucking reason the cameras in this season are shakey as hell. It’s like every single shot is being shot by John, The Camera Man With Parkinsons, and no one had the heart to take the fucking camera from him.

Anyways, Vadic finds them, the captain is injured and IMMEDIATELY gives control of the ship over to Riker. Coward. Picard is his #1. That’s cute.

We find out that Worf was actually Raffi’s handler and is working with Starfleet Intelligence. He showed up to save Raffi because she DID tell him she was gonna do it and he knew she’s just get herself killed, which she almost did, so that’s fair. The two of them team up to try and figure out wtf is going on. Raffi is not used to someone believing in her, obviously.

The Titan tries to run, and Vadic fires a portal device which traps them in a loop. It’s the same kind of attack that the terrorist attack was. Riker and Picard are at extreme odds here. Picard’s like “FIGHT HER, KILL KILL” and Riker’s only goal is to make sure people don’t fucking die and they can get out of this. We did not need this :)

Some Ensign basically tries to kill Jack. He’s got a weird melty face. As Jack is lying there dying of some kind of gas leak, he sees something saying “COME TO ME” represented by Seven as weird tendrils form out of the walls. Cool! The Zerg are here!

Worf has gotten a lot more chill with his old age, which is kinda neat. It’d be cool if he wasn’t the same shitty character he was in DS9. We STILL see a torture scene there, which is lovely. Anyways, the guy is ACTUALLY a… dun dun dun… CHANGELING! Worf explains that he knew the Changelings were in charge, as a friend of his in the link told him about this. Basically, some Changelings broke away to form a terrorist sect to continue the Dominion war. But Starfleet can’t acknowledge they’re existence, or it’d reignite the Dominion war. I dunno… why? Just because a rogue faction from a country attacks another, doesn’t mean we’d go to war, that’d be like us going to war with Afghanistan after- ohhhhh noooo.

Riker FINALLY listens to Picard, who’s been like “KILL KILL KILL” this whole time, aaaand the Titan immediately loses the fight. Whoops.

So far I like some parts of this but it’s held back by bad pacing and some dumb moments. This could have been a movie. Maybe even a two part movie. This could have been an email.

No Win Scenario - PIC 7.5/10

We get a scene of real life Patrick Stewart trying to eat his bar food in peace when some fucking nerds walk up to him and try and ask him a bunch of questions. For real though, it’s cadets asking him how he escapes a Hirogen. wtf I wanna see that??? He turns it into a life lesson cause he’s Jean Luc Fucking Picard and that’s all he knows how to do, and his lesson is “there’s no such thing as a no win scenario”

Anyways so here’s an episode called No Win Scenario in which they are in a no win scenario. They’re falling into a gravity well, with no way to escape, and they have roughly an hour or two before they all fucking die. Riker tells Picard to go get to know his son and prepare to die. He’s just… given up.

Seven has not gotten that memo. She explains there’s a changeling sabetour on the ship to Riker, who’s like “keep it quiet. Morale is already shit. I’m not saying do NOTHING. But maybe… keep it quiet. You’re not reinstated, that’ll make it easier for you to work under the radar”. So she goes to the original captain.

I’m sorry, they don’t have enough power to divert to the propulsion systems and get out of this mess, but they DO have enough power to run the fucking holodeck so Picard can strike out at hanging out with his son???

We see Vadic chop her own hand off, and then it turns into a floating meat face that speaks with the voice of the fucking Zerg Overmind. It tells her to persue. She says no, that’d end with her dying too. It says pursue or it’ll kill her. She goes “alright, I guess I’ll persue then”. Then she swivels in her chair and giggles. I like her.

We jump between Picard being awkward with his son as Seven fights a gross meat Changeling.

We get TRAGIC SHAW BACKSTORY. He was a survivor of Wolf 359. He was arbitrarily chosen to survive by a lieutenant who pointed randomly at who gets to be in the 10 seater life pod. He lays into Picard, and while Jack AND us want to deck him in the face, Picard just leaves instead.

Beverley solves the problem. Hell yeah. She figures out how they can get of the nebula by using the energy contractions it has or whatever, AND convinces Riker to let them try to do this dangerous maneuver. Shaw comes out of his grumpy stupor to help them do some engineering stuff alongside Seven.

La Forge comes down to help out, DESPITE Seven saying “do not send anyone” in a secret transmission, AND her calling her Commander Annika. La Forge calls her Commander Seven. Seven starts BLASTING, killing the changeling. “She calls me Seven out of respect.” And Shaw, who has never respected her and is a shit head, is like “Oh I see.”

They ride the shockwave, blasting out of the Nebula. It’s actually kinda cool. They fly out of the nebula…. and right into Vadic. So they use the ASTEROID they were towing and fucking CHUCK IT AT HER.

“Will, did you just throw an asteroid??” “You’re god damn right I did.”

Turns out the Nebula was a Space Amoeba nursery or something. Space Babbies. Spabbies.

This was all cool. And Trekky. We just coulda done without the weird animosity that was brewing for the past three episodes.

At the end Picard also realizes that he HAD met Jack before, once. In that bar at the start, where Jack had been with the cadets and asking “well sir, have you ever done anything… outside of Starfleet? Had a real family?” and Picard went “Pff, Starfleet is the only family I’ve ever needed,” as the cadets APPLAUD this man tearing his son’s heart out of its chest.

These four episodes easily coulda been two, but like, this WAS a good episode.

Imposter - PIC 7/10

The Titan is on its way back home, when suddenly Jack walks on the bridge and just fucking kills everyone. Then Silent Hill F goop happens. Nope, it’s all in his mind, as his eyes are glowing red.

Starfleet is on its way, and Picard intends to bear the brunt of it. But all that is a little dulled in the matter of the fact that somehow a Changeling got on board. They have internal imaging scanners that can detect goopy people, it’s been standard issue since the Dominion War.

This is all occasionally interspersed with Worf and Raffi doing spy stuff and kinda failing at it. It’s kind of wild how extremely disconnected from all this they are.

Starfleet sends a security officer onboard, as Seven hides Jack somewhere. The officer is… RO LAREN! Remember her? :D Man, we did LOT leave on good terms, did we? Picard STILL has a massive stick up his ass even though it was 100% his fucking fault and he failed so hard. Thankfully, Riker calls him out on his bullshit. “YOU’RE the one who sent her into that knowing she’d have sympathies.”

Crusher studies the Changeling corpse. It’s not returned to goop, it bleeds even though it has no DNA. La Forge sees her own corpse and throws up. Fair.

Ro Laren starts questioning Picard and he IMMEDIATELY puts her on blast about every single tiny thing. “YOU’RE NOT EVEN WEARING YOUR BAJORAN EARRING, DID YOU TURN YOUR BACK ON ANOTHER INSITUTION?” God forbid a woman do fucking ANYTHING. Picard, check yourself, for gods sake.

Jack has more visions of himself killing people. You’d think he’d TELL someone that but no. He sees MORE and MORE visions and they’re getting very uncomfortably real.

Picard gets a message from Crusher that Changelings can now pass the blood test, trust no one, anyone can be a Changeling. So now he’s CONVINCED Ro is one cause he fucking hates her.

Ro has him take her to the corpse, but as they walk to it. As they do, Ro pulls a gun on him and drags him into the holodeck. It turns into a gun on gun standoff. THey just fucking YELL at each other, and it ends iwth “you broke my heart” “and you broke mine”. After all the emotions that flew out, they know that neither are changelings. They hate each other, but they trust each other in this moment. And Starfleet is compromised… as it always is for some fucking reason.

Raffi and Worf are captured by gangsters and have to fight to the death for their amusement. Worf is killed, which is kind of unceremoneous for one of the most important Trek characters. Ha, no, it was a ploy. He can meditate to stop his heart rate. He’s also bleeding out which is making him impatient for the interrogation. That’s the Worf I know.

We also learn that Ro Laren has been TRYING to do things behind the scenes to stop this conspiracy, but can’t trust anyone. She only has two agents in the field she REALLY trusts, and those are obviously Raffi and Worf. She leaves Picard, giving him her earring.

Obviously, her guards are also changelings, and they end up killing her, putting a bomb on her shuttle. She has no time to stop it, sending one last message to Picard, before sending her shuttle into the enemy’s nacelle so they have more time to escape.

Yet another major character death. Poor Ro, mistreated in canon to the very end. And now they’re all being framed for Ro’s death. I mean, at least this is a better death than Hugh. She has a heroic way going out, is “redeemed” (it’s not even really a redemption because she didn’t really NEED to be, it’s more that it fully cuts down Picard in that one episode), and is at least kinda cool.

The Changeling guards find Jack, and try to beam him out, but he just… fucking kills them all. All as he’s seeing more Silent Hill F tendrils and a weird door. What the fuck is even going on with this plot point?

Picard now realizes he didn’t even know what Ro meant to him. Yeah dude, you clearly did not. And that earring is secretly containing all of her corkboard information. This also connects them to Worf.

FINALLY Jake tells his mom “there’s something very wrong with me”. It only took her going “How did you know those FOUR PEOPLE you killed were changelings”.

entry.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 233 - Pokemon Red Glitch Showcase

link.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 233 - Pokemon Red Glitch Showcase

entry.content:
Yes, I AM uploading three of these in one day. The faster I get through Pokemon February the better.

So yeah, I did Pokemon Red and then for some fucking reason IMMEDIATELY did it again, but this time I did the glitch showcase. So Retro Achievements has “subsets”, which basically sequester out the weird-ass achievements to their own sets. Around this time they had actually implemented the ability to play subsets at the same time as the main set, which was kinda why I jumped on Pokemon to test it out. But this wasn’t the best one for that, cause I wasn’t doing shit like this in the main game.

There are only 8 achievements in this set, and every one of them involves intensive glitching. I did a crash course on Pokemon gen 1 glitches for this, most of which I already knew, but some I needed a bit of a refresher. It’s always fun to do stuff like this, so let’s go into detail, since there’s only 8.

#1: Escaping the Simulation

Use the invisible PC in Celadon

In Celadon there’s a hotel that uses the same layout as a Pokemon center. When they copy and pasted the map, they removed the PC, but did not remove the invisible event tile. Whoopsies! I used to do this as a kid, it’s silly.

#2: Ya Dun Goofed

Find a way to crash the game

Extremely easy to do, honestly. You will probably do this one by accident while trying to do the following one.

#3: Speedrun?

Enter the Hall of Fame with 1 minute or less on the clock

I usually hate speedrun achievements. But for subsets, they’re fine, and for this one, it’s not really “hard” and very interesting. So, there’s a way to beat the game in less than a minute through Arbitrary Code Execution, or ACE. Basically the idea is you glitch the Pokemon and Item menus so you can pick up and drag code in the game around to where you want it to go, and that will activate the end game sequence. If you’re following a guide, it’s extremely easy to do, and if you want to do it fast, it takes the tiniest amount of memorization and will take you like 3 tries at most.

If you fuck it up you crash the game, so hey, that makes the previous achievement free!

#4: No Experience Necessary

Get the Pokemon in your first party slot from level 1 to level 100 in one battle

This one seems pretty wtf, but it’s not that bad if you get a glitched Pokemon through the Mew Glitch, which I’ll explain later on.

#5: Rare Candy Addiction

Stockpile 255 Rare Candies

The Missingno glitch is one of the most well known glitches of all time. You almost certainly know about it. If you talk to the old man, then fly to Cinnebar, and swim against the right side, it will summon glitch pokemon. One of these will increase the items in your 6th bag slot by 128. Simply have one rare candy there, glitch, then throw 2, then glitch again, and boom, you have 255. I’ve done this dozens of times honestly.

#6: Ruining the Neighborhood

Enter Glitch City by breaking the Safari Zone

Another one I did as a kid, this one is fun. To do this one, follow these instructions:

Go into the Safari Zone, pay the 500 to enter. Once you enter, turn back around and leave, then refuse to actually leave and re-enter. Once you’ve re-entered, turn back around and once again the attendant will ask you if you REALLY want to leave. Say no again. Then, save the game and restart the console.

When you start the game back up, try and leave again. This time, the attendant will NOT ask you if you want to leave, but instead if you want to enter. Refuse, and leave. Then go to any other map, walk around for the 500 steps, and boom, you’re in Glitch City.

It’s a real neat glitch. Just fly away to fix it.

#6: The Third Starter Wasn’t Alone

Defeat Professor Oak while he has the starter neither you nor your rival chose

In the game data is an unused trainer battle against Professor Oak in which he uses the unused starter evolution. This is a very high level trainer battle, higher than the champion, and seems like it was gonna be a cool bonus boss, but was sadly cut from the game. But we don’t have to put up with that.

The Mew Glitch is a very famous and very important glitch. By flying away at the same time you enter into a trainer’s field of view, you will enter a glitched state. If you then encounter a Pokemon as the most recent Pokemon you’ve seen, when you return to that original trainer’s location, you will get into a wild battle against a Pokemon based on that Pokemon’s stats.

https://puu.sh/257S This is a map of every trainer in the game and all the Pokemon you can find using the trainers. But sometimes, you gotta take matters into your own hands.

If you get a Pokemon with a special stat of exactly 226, you can encounter a ditto. Then, growl at it either 4 times for Charizard, 5 times for Venusaur, or 6 times for Blastoise. Then, return to the original trainer, and boom. Professor Oak.

This FEELS like a super intensive and complex glitch, and it’s certainly more so than the old man glitch, but it’s really shockingly easy to do. And if you know how to this glitch, you can….
